question: The Harbour phase of the 29th edition of the Singapore-India Maritime Bilateral Exercise (SIMBEX)-2022, hosted by the Indian Navy, was held at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishakhapatnam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vishakhapatnam** is a coastal city in the southeastern state of **Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• It is home to the **Eastern Naval Command **of the Indian Navy, which has the necessary infrastructure to host the** Harbour phase of SIMBEX-2022****.**
 
• **SIMBEX** is an **annual bilateral naval exercise** conducted between the **Indian Navy **and the **Republic of Singapore Navy** (RSN) since **1993.**
 
• The exercise aims to enhance mutual cooperation and interoperability between the two navies, and includes a range of activities such as **air defense, anti-submarine warfare, maritime security, and search and rescue operations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Guwahati** is a city in the northeastern state of **Assam** and does not have a coast or a naval base.
 
• **Kolkata** is a city in the eastern state of **West Bengal **and although it has a port, it is primarily a** commercial port **and not a naval base.
 
• **Koch** is a city in the southern state of **Kerala **and does have a naval base, but it is primarily used for training and does not have the infrastructure to host a large-scale naval exercise like SIMBEX.
 
• The two stages of **SIMBEX-2023** were the **Harbour Phase**, which took place in Singapore from September 21 to 24, 2023, and the **Sea Phase.**
 
• In addition to Kavaratti, Sindhukesari, and Ranvijay, **Long-Range Maritime Patrol Aircraft P8I t**ook part in the drill.
